_comment: Passed via `claude --settings <this-file>` by scripts/launch-topic.sh when the proxy spawns a topic session. Enables telegram@zamua JUST for that session (the global settings.json keeps its own telegram disabled so no other claude spawns a competing getUpdates poller). The permissions.allow of the 4 channel tools is redundant under --permission-mode auto (which auto-approves routine calls) but harmless. NB: AskUserQuestion is removed via the launcher's --disallowedTools= CLI flag, NOT a settings key here - the disallowedTools SETTINGS key is not honored for it (verified live: the model still rendered the tool); only the CLI flag (= form) removes it.
